process_copy.heading: Mint the ebook NFT
process_copy.body: Buy your ebook NFT for $15 USD. The mint number you receive becomes your referral code.

process_copy.heading: Earn Through Referrals
process_copy.body: Share either your mint number or your link. Whenever someone mints with it, you immediately earn $5 USD. There are no limits and no expiration. If no code is provided, the $5 and Small Block ticket are awarded to a random existing ticket holder.

process_copy.heading: Build Up Tickets
process_copy.body: Every referral also awards you a Small Block prize ticket. More referrals means more tickets and greater chances.

process_copy.heading: Enter the Prize Draws
process_copy.body: The remaining prize mechanic provides never-ending $500 prizes, with community members having equal chances to participate. Chainlink VRF selects winners randomly and fairly.

process_copy.heading: Receive Your Rewards
process_copy.body: Commissions are delivered automatically on-chain. Prize wins are posted on the Winners page and can be claimed with one click.

decisions.reason: The hero copy mentions prize-draw tickets generically and remains valid for the surviving Small Block prize mechanic.
Removing Big Blocks does not change the hero section's location or content structure.
The decision about Big Blocks and revenue allocation does not affect displaying the book cover on the landing page.
A same-message MODIFY already records the $5 founder allocation, $5 affiliate allocation, and $5 Small Block prize-pool allocation without retaining Big Block funding.
A same-message MODIFY already removes the obsolete big_block_ticket_counter_visible attribute while preserving the valid Small Block counter and badges.
The source removes the separate Big Block mechanic but does not explicitly replace the established Small Block draw amount, cadence, funding persistence, or eligibility rules.
Removing Big Block tickets leaves the independently defined Small Block ticket issuance, eligibility window, reset, and carryover rules unchanged.
Chainlink VRF selection remains applicable to the surviving Small Block prize draw; the source does not change the provider or selection execution.
Removing Big Blocks does not change the automatic wallet payout method or Winners-page announcement behavior for remaining prizes.
